verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's first-party billing docs cover budgets that track actual spend against planned spend, budget notifications (alerts), and programmatic cost-control responses via Pub/Sub. The Billing API also allows programmatic management, so budgets and alerts are clearly delivered. Nothing in the pack documents anomaly detection on spend, which the story explicitly asks for. missing for 10: documented spend anomaly detection, evidence that budgets/alerts are configurable from day one (e.g., default or onboarding setup), independent or hands-on corroboration that alerts prevent surprise bills.
